moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-inoutback, written here): Target dips −10.5 % (at 21 % of the time) and overshoots +10.5 % (at 79 %) before landing at 100 %, 600 ms, cubic-bezier(.68,−.6,.32,1.6) ≈ GSAP back.inOut(1.7). Site rule: eye-catching, do not overuse. Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.6 s) · ease (back.inOut(1.7) | custom .68,−.6,.32,1.6).
